title: Mean of a biased sign indicator
statement: Let $0<p<1$ and choose one of two coordinates, $i\in\{0,1\}$. For two independent signs, each equal to $-1$ with probability $p$, the mean of the indicator that the sign in coordinate $i$ is $-1$ is $p$.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is one of the two coordinates
